build_alphafold3_model: build an Alphafold3 model with specified atom input dimensions, MSA modules, and diffusion parameters
sample_atom_positions: sample atom 3D coordinates from the ElucidatedAtomDiffusion model using a noise schedule and preconditioned network
compute_confidence_scores: compute pLDDT, pTM, and iPTM confidence scores from the ConfidenceHead logits for predicted structures
predict_distogram_logits: predict pairwise distance distribution logits from the DistogramHead using pairwise representations
select_best_model: select the best model from a set of sampled structures using weighted lDDT and global PDE scoring
